03 / A LITTLE ABOUT MESTILL LEARNING. ALWAYS CURIOUS.

A student of science.
Always a learner.

CURIOSITY IS WHERE IT BEGINS.

Science has always been my way of asking questions about the world. Education is becoming my way of sharing that curiosity.

I'm Jewel B. Octa, a Bachelor of Secondary Education student majoring in Science at the University of Camarines Norte. Through Field Study 1, I've been connecting what I learn in college with the realities of the classroom.

I still remember a Grade 7 science lesson when a teacher's encouragement gave me the confidence to speak up. That experience stays with me: learning is also about feeling safe enough to ask, try, and make mistakes.
